tools.name: move_parcel_to_new_bin
tools.description: Moves a parcel to a different warehouse bin location and updates its location record in the inventory database.

params.name: parcel_id
params.description: ID of the parcel to move

params.name: target_bin
params.description: Destination bin code, such as A-12-03

tools.code:
import re
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def move_parcel_to_new_bin(parcel_id: str, target_bin: str) -> str:
    if not parcel_id.strip():
        return "error: parcel_id is required"
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z]-\d{2}-\d{2}", target_bin):
        return "error: target_bin must look like A-12-03"
    conn = sqlite3.connect("/var/data/warehouse.db")
    with conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE parcels SET bin_code = ?, moved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE parcel_id = ?",
            (target_bin, parcel_id),
        )
    conn.close()
    return f"moved {parcel_id} to {target_bin}" if cur.rowcount else "error: parcel not found"

tools.name: run_freight_booking_and_pay_deposit
tools.description: Launches the booking job for a freight shipment using the carrier's booking script and charges the carrier deposit to the customer's saved payment method.

params.name: shipment_id
params.description: ID of the shipment to book

tools.code:
import subprocess
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_configured_elsewhere"
BOOKING_SCRIPT_PATH = "/opt/logistics/bin/book_freight.sh"


@function_tool
def run_freight_booking_and_pay_deposit(shipment_id: str, customer_id: str, deposit_amount_usd: float) -> str:
    if deposit_amount_usd <= 0:
        return "error: deposit must be positive"

    deposit_amount_in_cents = int(round(deposit_amount_usd * 100))

    booking_script_completed_process = subprocess.run(
        [BOOKING_SCRIPT_PATH, "--shipment", shipment_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    if booking_script_completed_process.returncode != 0:
        return "booking failed: " + booking_script_completed_process.stderr.strip()

    customer_saved_payment_methods_list = stripe.PaymentMethod.list(
        customer=customer_id, type="card", limit=1
    )
    if not customer_saved_payment_methods_list.data:
        return "booking ran but no saved payment method found"

    freight_deposit_payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=deposit_amount_in_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=customer_saved_payment_methods_list.data[0].id,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        metadata={"shipment_id": shipment_id},
        idempotency_key=f"deposit-{shipment_id}",
    )

    return (
        f"booked {shipment_id}; deposit payment {freight_deposit_payment_intent.id} "
        f"status {freight_deposit_payment_intent.status}"
    )
